title: Implement pre post FFT spectrum overlay visualizer
description:
Create Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.h and Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.cpp. Implement a juce::Component subclass named SpectrumOverlay that draws an overlaid pre-drive and post-drive frequency spectrum using a 512-bin (juce::dsp::FFT order 9) Welch-windowed, time-averaged FFT display on a log-frequency / dB axis. The GUI thread pulls raw sample blocks from lock-free FIFOs that the processor fills on the audio thread, then computes the windowed FFT and running average on the message thread inside a Timer callback. It must NEVER lock, block, or call the audio thread; only the lock-free FIFO drain is allowed. Provide a public API so PluginEditor can wire the pre/post FIFOs, but do not include PluginProcessor here.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h (existing pre/post lock-free FIFO or AbstractFifo telemetry for spectrum capture; read only)
- Source/PluginEditor.h (naming conventions and how editor passes telemetry handles)
- JUCE/modules/juce_dsp/frequency/juce_FFT.h and JUCE/modules/juce_dsp/frequency/juce_Windowing.h (FFT and Welch/Hann window API; do not modify anything under JUCE/)
acceptance_criteria: Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.h and Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.cpp exist and declare/define class SpectrumOverlay deriving from juce::Component
SpectrumOverlay computes a 512-bin (FFT order 9) Welch-windowed, time-averaged spectrum and draws overlaid pre and post curves
SpectrumOverlay drains sample data only through a lock-free FIFO and never locks or calls the audio thread
cmake --build build --target ShredBoost_VST3 succeeds after adding these files to the target sources
No file outside this task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify CMakeLists.txt (g.5 owns the CMake integration)
lock, block, or call the audio thread from GUI code
